definitions.explanation: A product that has been recently developed and released onto the market.

examples.japanese: {新製品|しんせいひん}が{発売|はつばい}された。
examples.english: A new product has been released.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{秋|あき}に{新製品|しんせいひん}の{発表会|はっぴょうかい}がある。
examples.english: Every year in autumn, there is a new product announcement event.

examples.japanese: この{新製品|しんせいひん}は{従来品|じゅうらいひん}より{三割|さんわり}{軽|かる}くて{使|つか}いやすい。
examples.english: This new product is 30% lighter and easier to use than the previous model.

notes:
{新製品|しんせいひん} is a compound of {新|しん} (new) + {製品|せいひん} (manufactured product). It refers to newly developed and released items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新製品|しんせいひん}を{発売|はつばい}する: to release a new product
- {新製品|しんせいひん}の{開発|かいはつ}: new product development
- {新製品|しんせいひん}{発表会|はっぴょうかい}: product launch event
- {新製品|しんせいひん}レビュー: new product review

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新商品|しんしょうひん}: new product (more from the seller/retail perspective)
- {新型|しんがた}: new model (often for cars, electronics)
- {最新|さいしん}モデル: latest model

USAGE:
Common in business, marketing, and consumer contexts. {新製品|しんせいひん} emphasizes that the item was manufactured/produced, while {新商品|しんしょうひん} emphasizes it as something for sale.
